verdict.rationale: Flagsmith explicitly markets and documents SDK coverage across server-side, web, and mobile ('Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps'), plus 15+ language SDKs integrating with frameworks like React and Next.js, all built on the same core flag/segment/identity model ensuring consistent behavior. Missing for 10: no independent third-party verification of cross-SDK behavioral consistency, and evidence notes flag evaluation is primarily server-side rather than uniformly local across all SDKs, which could introduce subtle behavioral differences.
